items.title: US reportedly warns Gulf allies of possible Iran strikes from 4 November, while talks on reopening Hormuz continue
items.summary: The Times of Israel's 31 October live blog reports the US warned Gulf allies that strikes on Iran could come as early as 4 November, the day after the midterms. Fox News says Secretary of State Rubio said no decision has been made on resuming military action, and other reports say Tehran sees a softer tone in a letter from Vice President Vance and talks on a two-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz are under way. Reports conflict on how close any strike is, so treat this as provisional.
items.why: Gulf escalation or a deal moves oil prices, which feed into corporate budgets, hiring and marketing spend.

items.title: The Iran war has pulled US attention and air-defence resources away from Ukraine
items.summary: Wikipedia's article on Ukraine in the 2026 Iran war says Ukraine has shifted from mainly receiving Western military aid to offering drone-defence expertise. No dated Ukraine battlefield update was found today, so this is background context from a reference page, not a news report.
items.why: Shows how one conflict reshapes defence supply chains and the skills in demand.

items.title: Banking liquidity surplus has shrunk to about 46,200 crore rupees as the RBI defends the rupee (late October)
items.summary: A Business Standard headline reports excess liquidity fell from a peak of about 11 trillion rupees in early September to 46,200 crore as of October, tied to the RBI's rupee defence. Separately, Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta told a Business Standard summit that growth has held up despite global shocks but dependence on imported oil and external finance remains a challenge. Nothing dated 1 November turned up, and the figures come from search-result headlines, so treat them as provisional.
items.why: Tighter liquidity and a weak rupee raise funding costs and can slow hiring and consumer spending.

items.title: Sensex and Nifty rebounded on 29 October; markets are shut on Sunday (3 days old)
items.summary: Search results give the last verified close as 29 October: the Nifty 50 up 237.90 points (1.05%) to 22,936.75 and the Sensex up 905.01 points to 74,151.04, with Reliance rising on buying after the Jio Platforms listing. A newer Friday session was not confirmed in these results, and crude oil was cited as a drag, so treat the levels as provisional.
items.why: Market sentiment changes recruiters' risk appetite and campus-hiring plans.

items.title: Reliance's latest profit figure is unclear across sources
items.summary: One broker page dated 31 October shows a net profit rise of 27.17% to about 29,250 crore rupees, but the same page's period labels conflict, so the figure is unreliable until checked against Reliance's own filing.
items.why: A caution about quoting earnings numbers from aggregator pages.

items.title: Google, Microsoft, OpenAI and Anthropic back one robots.txt opt-out for AI training
items.summary: SiliconANGLE and Engadget (30 to 31 October) report the four firms will support a single setting that lets sites block AI training crawlers. Anthropic says it has started, OpenAI says coming months, Microsoft from 1 February 2027 and Google in 2027. Critics, including an Inc. column, note it does not stop AI products from using web content to answer questions.
items.why: Content rights and consent are becoming a marketing and brand-policy issue.

items.title: OpenAI reportedly cut its funding round to 20 billion dollars after raising 11 billion
items.summary: A headline attributed to the Wall Street Journal says OpenAI cut its funding round to 20 billion dollars after raising 11 billion. Only the headline appeared in search, with no article text, so the details are unverified and provisional.
items.why: Signals how investor appetite is shaping AI vendors that employers rely on.

items.title: ChatGPT will stop giving teenagers practical weapons and security-system information
items.summary: The Next Web reports OpenAI said on Friday that ChatGPT will stop giving teens practical information about weapons and security systems, with a Community Safety Report due in early 2027.
items.why: Safety policy is now a visible part of consumer AI brand positioning.
